newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi started his visit to Romania on Monday. He re-iterated his country's support for Romania's fast admission to NATO and the European Union. He also praised Romania's decision to send troops to Albania.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said Romania and Italy recently signed a strategic partnership accord and were determined to boost bilateral ties.
* President Emil Constantinescu met the leaders of the country's ruling coalition to discuss the provisions of a Romanian-Ukrainian basic treaty initialled on Saturday in Kiev.
* The ruling National Peasant party hailed the treaty with Ukraine as a firm guarantee for Romania's security.
* Defence Minister Victor Babiuc started tour to Germany, Norway and the Netherlands as part of Bucharest's efforts to get early NATO admission.
* Romania's former King Michael ended visit in the eastern city of Iasi, as part of his longest tour across the country since the government restored his Romanian citizenship earlier this year.
